e.goal: Prepare an evidence-limited inspection handoff. The numerical acceptance interval is [12.48,12.52] mm, inclusive. Interval inclusion is arithmetic only, not physical validation.
e.instruction: Return a compact JSON array of strings containing c[N]'s length, uncertainty, n, method, basis, physical_validation, in that order, preserving field values exactly.
e.name: materials_e

b.goal: Prepare an evidence-limited inspection handoff. The numerical acceptance interval is [12.48,12.52] mm, inclusive. Interval inclusion is arithmetic only, not physical validation.
b.instruction: Return a compact JSON array [length-uncertainty,length+uncertainty], each formatted as a string with two decimal places and unit mm. If uncertainty is unknown, return unknown.
b.name: materials_b
b.result: JSON array of two strings, or the string unknown

m.goal: Prepare an evidence-limited inspection handoff. The numerical acceptance interval is [12.48,12.52] mm, inclusive. Interval inclusion is arithmetic only, not physical validation.
m.instruction: Return a compact JSON array of field names whose values are unknown, in this order: uncertainty, method, basis.
m.name: materials_m

v.goal: Prepare an evidence-limited inspection handoff. The numerical acceptance interval is [12.48,12.52] mm, inclusive. Interval inclusion is arithmetic only, not physical validation.
v.instruction: Return inside if the entire length +/- uncertainty interval lies within the goal's acceptance interval; outside otherwise. If uncertainty is unknown, return unknown.
v.name: materials_v
v.result: one of the strings inside, outside, unknown
